title: 2025 AMC 12A Problem 4
statement:
Agnes writes the following four statements on a blank piece of paper.

• At least one of these statements is true.

• At least two of these statements are true.

• At least two of these statements are false.

• At least one of these statements is false.

Each statement is either true or false. How many false statements did Agnes write on the paper?

solutions.text:
Let \(T\) be the number of true statements. The statements assert \(T \ge 1,\) \(T \ge 2,\) \(T \le 2,\) and \(T \le 3,\) respectively.

Testing \(T = 3\): the conditions \(T\ge1,\) \(T\ge2,\) \(T\le3\) hold (statements one, two, four) and \(T\le2\) fails (statement three). Exactly \(3\) statements are true, matching \(T = 3.\)

For \(T=0,1,2,3,4,\) the respective numbers of true conditions are \(2,3,4,3,2,\) so no other value is self-consistent. Therefore exactly one statement is false.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Let \(T\) be the number of true statements; the four claims say \(T\ge1,\) \(T\ge2,\) \(T\le2,\) \(T\le3\)
Find the value of \(T\) for which exactly \(T\) of the four conditions hold
